chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umeyr, from Al-Husayn ibn Usman, from a man, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:

When you eat food, say 'Bismillah' at its beginning and its end. For if the servant mentions the Name before eating, Satan does not eat with him; and if he does not mention the Name, Satan eats with him. So when he mentions the Name after having eaten, and Satan had eaten with him, Satan vomits what he had eaten.
ai.seo_question: What is the spiritual significance of saying Bismillah before and after eating according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This narration from al-Kafi emphasizes the spiritual efficacy of the Basmala as a protective barrier against Shaytan, a concept central to Shia daily adab. The unique detail that reciting after eating causes Satan to 'vomit' what he consumed highlights the dynamic nature of divine remembrance in reclaiming spiritual and physical sustenance. This practice underscores the belief that mundane acts like eating are opportunities for spiritual purification and victory over the lower self.

en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Al Husayn Bin Usman, from a man, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘When you eat the food, so say, ‘In the Name of Allahazwj’ at the beginning of it and at its end, for if the servant Names (Bismillah) before he eats, the Satanla does not eat with him, but when he does not Name (Bismillah), the Satanla does eat with him. So when he Names (Bismillah) after having eaten, and the Satanla had eaten with him, the Satanla vomits what he had eaten’.
en.sarwar: 11. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘Umayr from al-Husayn ibn ‘Uthman from a man who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘

When you eat food say, ‘In the name of Allah’ at its beginning and at its end’; when a servant says it before he eats, Satan cannot eat with him; but if he did not mention the name of Allah, Satan eats with him. If he then says, ‘In the name of Allah’ after he begins and Satan had been eating with him, Satan then throws up what he had eaten.’”
